name: Add virtual AIS to deposited DSGC and re-run t0067 channel sweep on AIS
short_description: Append a 30 um AIS + 1 mm passive axon to the deposited Poleg-Polsky cell and re-run the t0067 channel-density sweep with all 5 channels (Nav1.6, NaP, NaR, Kv3, Kv4) inserted on the AIS instead of the soma. 16 conditions x 2 directions x 5 seeds = 160 FULL trials.
